items.title: When does optimizing the proxy start hurting the real target?
items.description: The proxy score always climbs with more optimization pressure — that's why it looked like a good proxy. Drag 'proxy-target correlation' down to model a weaker proxy (like padding test coverage without improving real quality) and watch where the real target peaks and then declines.
items.compute: const p = params.pressure; const c = params.correlation; const proxyScore = Math.min(100, 40 + 0.6 * p); const realTarget = Math.max(0, 40 + 0.6 * p - Math.pow(p, 2) * (1 - c) * 0.01); return { proxyScore, realTarget };
